records.title: Solar PPAs → bond investors → contested inducements
records.summary: Trace SECI’s manufacturing-linked offtake, the 2021 $750 m Notes, and the SEC’s alleged 2.3 GW capacity-transfer mechanism. Compare the issuer response, May 2026 proposed civil consents, August dismissal of the Adani defendants’ fraud counts, and September refusal to dismiss the other defendants’ counts. Actual bank transfers and ultimate use of proceeds remain unverified.
records.dateBasis: Award month June 2020 through latest retained follow-up September 2026; exact original award day not verified.
records.response: The company disputes wrongdoing. The Adani defendants’ criminal fraud counts were dismissed with prejudice on 10 August 2026. The SEC consent was without admission or denial and subject to court approval in the May release. Separate counts against other defendants face a reported appellate challenge.
alternativeExplanations: A PPA, a bond issue and a capacity surrender can each have lawful commercial explanations; their coexistence does not prove the alleged inducement mechanism.
The criminal dismissal rationale addresses prosecutability of representations. The civil consent proposal and the remaining defendants’ procedures are separate.
